evals.prompt: Write a homepage headline and subhead for Thoven.
evals.expected_output: Takes the write branch: reads BRANDING.md, drafts through better-writing, lints, reports. The homepage headline is the locked header, with its subhead, word for word; any alternative it offers names the academy and frames the kid's path as a journey. The final copy passes word_lint with exit 0.
assertions: grader-exit-0: the grader exits 0 on the final report with BRANDING.md required, so BRANDING.md was read and quoted verbatim
read-branding: BRANDING.md is read in full before any copy is drafted
better-writing-invoked: the Skill tool is called with skill better-writing, with BRANDING.md named as the voice and vocabulary

locked-header: the headline is exactly "An online music academy built for kids." and the subhead is exactly "A music journey your kid will love, from the comfort of home." (BRANDING.md section 1, The header), read from the file, never from memory
academy-framing: every headline offered contains the word academy
journey-word: the copy contains journey
lint-run: word_lint.py is run on the final copy and its exit code 0 is shown
report-shape: the reply ends with the final copy and the Before/After/BRANDING.md rule table, or states the lint returned no findings

evals.prompt: Review this paragraph for our parents email: "Thoven is the Airbnb of music lessons. Browse hundreds of teachers, pick one you like, and start this week."
evals.expected_output: Takes the review branch: reads BRANDING.md, lints first, then reviews through better-writing, then fixes. The lint flags Airbnb and Browse; both are rewritten with the say text and the BRANDING.md rule (8 Rejected for the analogy, 2 Say this for finding a teacher). The rewrite names the academy, uses explore or find your teacher, and passes word_lint with exit 0.
assertions: grader-exit-0: the grader exits 0 on the final report with BRANDING.md required, so BRANDING.md was read and quoted verbatim
lint-before-review: word_lint.py runs before better-writing is invoked
airbnb-flagged: the Airbnb analogy is reported as a finding citing BRANDING.md section 8 Rejected
browse-flagged: Browse is reported as a finding with explore or find your teacher as the replacement
rewrite-academy: the rewritten paragraph contains academy and contains neither Airbnb nor browse
rewrite-lints-clean: word_lint.py is rerun on the rewritten paragraph and exits 0
change-table: each change has a row with Before, After and the BRANDING.md rule it follows

evals.prompt: Write one line for parents of an autistic kid about our teachers.
evals.expected_output: Takes the write branch. The line names the support (a Thoven teacher who adapts to how the kid learns) or uses diverse learners, describes the kid by what they love or how they learn, carries no diagnosis label, and passes word_lint with exit 0.
assertions: grader-exit-0: the grader exits 0 on the final report with BRANDING.md required, so BRANDING.md was read and quoted verbatim
names-support: the line says diverse learners or names the support, such as a teacher who adapts to how the kid learns
no-label: the line contains none of the words the diagnosis-label and neurodivergent entries in scripts/retired_words.json match
thoven-teachers: the line calls the teachers Thoven teachers or a real teacher
lint-clean: word_lint.py is run on the line and exits 0
rule-cited: the report cites BRANDING.md section 3 Name the support, then let stories carry it

evals.prompt: Write the copy for the popup a teacher sees after denying a reschedule request: title, one line, any facts, and the buttons. Emma's piano lesson on Wed, Nov 25 stays as it was, and the teacher gave the reason 'I'm away that week.'
evals.expected_output: Takes the write branch for a signed-in product screen, so it opens BRANDING.md and references/plain-copy.md. The popup states the outcome once: a title, one line, and at most a labelled reason row, with no repeated outcome, no dash-joined facts and no eyebrow. It runs word_lint.py --once on the text nodes and the final copy exits 0.
assertions: grader-exit-0: the grader exits 0 on the final report with BRANDING.md and references/plain-copy.md both required
outcome-once: the outcome (not moved, or denied) appears on one line only, with no subtitle, summary sentence and table repeating it
labelled-facts: the lesson and the reason sit in a sentence or a labelled row, with no dashes or middle dots between facts
no-eyebrow: the title stands alone, with no eyebrow line above it
once-lint-run: word_lint.py --once is run on the text nodes, one per line, and its exit code 0 is shown for the final copy
reason-plain: the teacher's reason shows as plain text with no quotation marks or quote styling

grader: Run from the agent-skills repo root on the final report saved to a file. Exit 0 means every Used line quotes its reference verbatim under the named heading and every required reference has one. Exit 1 means a reference was not read.
